user.title: Which registry
user.description: Recordings and backups are locked here at home with your password and then stored in a container image registry. A free public registry is fine for this, because nothing in it can be read without your password.

data_description.registry: Docker Hub and GitHub are known by name. Choose Other for a registry of your own.
data_description.address: Only for Other. For example registry.example.com. Plain http is accepted only for a registry on your own network.

sign_in.title: Sign in
sign_in.description:
Make an access token that can read and write, then paste it here.

1. Open the registry's access token page: {token_page}
2. Make a token that can read and write.
3. Paste your account name and the token below.

The token is kept hidden on this system and used only to talk to {registry}. Your account password is never asked for.

data_description.username: The name of your account on the registry.
data_description.token: The access token you just made. It is not your account password.

password.title: Your password locks everything

data.understand: I know that if I forget this password, nothing stored there can be opened by anyone

data_description.password: At least 14 characters. Not a common password.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: One repository holds everything by default. Any camera, and backups, can have their own later. A repository that does not exist yet is made for you.

data_description.repository: In the form account/name, lower case. For example your-account/home-vault.

restore_key.title: Type your password again
restore_key.description: The key made from your password is not kept in backups, so that a copy of a backup can never open what is stored. It is missing here, for example after a restore. Type your password to make it again.

data_description.password: The password you chose when you added this place.

finish.title: Ready
finish.description:
The repository {repository} is {visibility}.

Everything put there is locked first. Select Submit to add this place.

repositories.title: Repositories
repositories.description: Everything goes to {default} unless a camera or the backups have their own repository. {count} cameras have their own now. A repository that does not exist yet is made for you.

data_description.camera: Choose a camera to give it its own repository. Leave empty to change only the backups.
data_description.repository: In the form account/name. Leave empty to send this camera back to the default.
data_description.backups_repository: Leave empty to use the default repository.

password.title: Change the password
password.description:
The old password is required. The new password locks what is stored from now on; stored recordings are not sent again. Anyone who already copied the locked files can still open them with the old password.

Last try: {strength}
